import os,glob,re,json,collections,math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def bbox(ps): return (min(p[0] for p in ps),max(p[0] for p in ps),min(p[1] for p in ps),max(p[1] for p in ps))
for k in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']
    nz={v:[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==v] for v in set(v for r_ in g for v in r_) if v!=0}
    fcol=None
    for v,ps in nz.items():
        br=bbox(ps)
        other=[p for q in nz if q!=v for p in nz[q]]
        if all(br[0]<=p[0]<=br[1] and br[2]<=p[1]<=br[3] for p in other): fcol=v; break
    fp=bbox(nz[fcol]); inn=[v for v in nz if v!=fcol][0]; ib=bbox(nz[inn])
    epts=bbox([(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==inn])
    # distances: inner to grid edge vs ring thickness?
    print(k,'frame',fp,'inner',ib,'ring_ext',epts,
          'gap_top',ib[0]-fp[0],'gap_bot',fp[1]-ib[1],
          'dist_inner_grid_edge',(ib[0],len(g)-1-ib[1],ib[2],len(g[0])-1-ib[3]),
          'ring_thick',(epts[0]-fp[0],fp[1]-epts[1],epts[2]-fp[2],fp[3]-epts[3]))

import os,glob,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for k in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    nz={v:[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==v] for v in set(v for r_ in g for v in r_) if v!=0}
    fcol=None
    for v,ps in nz.items():
        br=(min(p[0] for p in ps),max(p[0] for p in ps),min(p[1] for p in ps),max(p[1] for p in ps))
        other=[p for q in nz if q!=v for p in nz[q]]
        if all(br[0]<=p[0]<=br[1] and br[2]<=p[1]<=br[3] for p in other): fcol=v; break
    inn=[v for v in nz if v!=fcol][0]
    fb=(min(p[0] for p in nz[fcol]),max(p[0] for p in nz[fcol]),min(p[1] for p in nz[fcol]),max(p[1] for p in nz[fcol]))
    pb=(min(p[0] for p in [(i,j) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]==inn]),
        max(p[0] for p in [(i,j) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]==inn]),
        min(p[1] for p in [(i,j) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]==inn]),
        max(p[1] for p in [(i,j) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]==inn]))
    print(k,'grid',(len(g),len(g[0])),'frame',fb,'painted',pb,

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def frames(g):
    # solid uniform-perimeter rectangles, color != bg, maximal candidates
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=[x for r in g for x in r]; bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    res=[]
    for av in sorted({x for r in g for x in r}-{bg}):
        pa={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==av}
        rs=[p[0] for p in pa];cs=[p[1] for p in pa]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h_,w_=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        ok=all(g[r0][c]==av and g[r1_][c]==av for c in range(c0,c1+1))and all(g[r][c0]==g[r][c1_]==av for r in range(r0,r1+1))
        per=2*h_+2*w_-4
        # count of av must equal perimeter
        if len(pa)!=per: continue
        res.append((h_*w_,(r0,r1,c0,c1_),av,len(pa)))
    return res
for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    gi,go=G['Demo pair %d input'%n],G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    print('demo',n,'solid-frame rects:',[(a,b,v,p) for a,b,v,p in frames(gi)])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n,fr,r0_,c0_ in [(1,(2,9,2,8),4),(3,(3,6,3,6),6),(2,(3,7,3,7),3)]:
    gi,go=G['Demo pair %d input'%n],G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    print('=== demo',n,'frame',(r0_[0],r0_[1],c0_[0],c0_[1]))
    for tt in range(1,6):
        o=ring(gi,tt,None,None,r0_[0],r0_[1],c0_[0],c0_[1])
        # need inner color: most common non-bg inside frame
        H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
        vals=[x for r in gi for x in r]; bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
        ins=[gi[i][j] for i in range(r0_[0]+1,r0_[1]) for j in range(c0_[0]+1,c0_[1])]
        bv=max(set(ins)-{bg},key=lambda v:ins.count(v))
        oo=ring(gi,tt,bv,None,r0_[0],r0_[1],c0_[0],c0_[1])
        mm=sum(1 for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if oo[r][c]!=go[r][c])
        print('  t=',tt,'mismatches',mm, 'bv=',bv)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def ring(g,t,bv,av,r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(max(0,r0_-t),min(H-1,r1_+t)+1):
        for c in range(max(0,c0_-t),min(W-1,c1_+t)+1):
            if g[r][c]!=av: out[r][c]=bv
    return out
test=[]
for n,fr,avcol in [(1,(2,9,2,8),4),(2,(3,7,3,7),3),(3,(3,6,3,6),6),(4,(3,8,3,8),5),(5,(3,5,3,5),1)]:
    gi,go=G['Demo pair %d input'%n],G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_=fr
    vals=[x for r in gi for x in r]; bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    ins=[gi[i][j] for i in range(r0_+1,r1_) for j in range(c0_+1,c1_)]
    bv=max(set(ins)-{bg},key=lambda v:ins.count(v))
    ok_ts=[tt for tt in range(1,8) if ring(gi,tt,bv,None,r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_)==go]
    test.append((n,ok_ts,(r1_-r0_+1),(c1_-c0_+1),(r1_-r0_//2)))  # h,w dims
    print(n,'match t=',ok_ts,'frame dims',(r1_-r0_+1,c1_-c0_+1),'inner colors',{x for x in set(ins)})

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    # locate frame bbox and inner block bbox
    fv=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x!=0]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in fv); r1=max(i for i,_ in fv); c0=min(j for _,j in fv); c1=max(j for _,j in fv)
    # block color = the minority color inside frame
    sub=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in sub for x in row if x!=sub[0][0])
    bv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    blk=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(sub) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==bv]
    br0=min(i for i,_ in blk); br1=max(i for i,_ in blk); bc0=min(j for _,j in blk); bc1=max(j for _,j in blk)
    # output: find the bv ring region
    ov=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(go) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==bv]
    ob_r0=min(i for i,_ in ov); ob_r1=max(i for i,_ in ov); ob_c0=min(j for _,j in ov); ob_c1=max(j for _,j in ov)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
ti=G['Test input']
def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # frame: union of non-bg cells
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in pts); r1=max(i for i,_ in pts)
    c0=min(j for _,j in pts); c1=max(j for _,j in pts)
    sub=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # inner block color = most common inside frame excluding frame border color
    fr=sub[0][0]
    inn=[sub[i][j] for i in range(1,len(sub)-1) for j in range(1,len(sub[0])-1) if sub[i][j]!=fr]
    bv=Counter(inn).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ih,iw=len(sub),len(sub[0])
    br0=sum(1 for i in range(ih) for j in range(iw) if sub[i][j]==bv)/iw  # rough
    # block bbox within frame
    blk=[(i,j) for i in range(ih) for j in range(iw) if sub[i][j]==bv]
    br0=min(i for i,_ in blk); br1=max(i for i,_ in blk); bc0=min(j for _,j in blk); bc1=max(j for _,j in blk)
    bh=br1-br0+1; bw=bc1-bc0+1
    t=int(-(-bh//2))+(bh==bw and bh%2==0)  # ceil(bh/2)+1 if square -> simplified: t = bh//2 + (bh%2==0 and bh%2!=1)
    # cleaner: t = bh//2 + (bh==bw and bh%2==0)
    t=bh//2 + (1 if (bh==bw and bh%2==0) else 0)
    fh,fw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    R0=r0-t; R1=r1+t; C0=c0-t; C1=c1+t
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(R0,R1+1):
        for j in range(C0,C1+1):
            ii,jj=i+t, j+t  # map into frame coords offset
            rv=row_off = i-r0; co = j-c0
            val = fr if (rv<1 or rv>=ih-1 or co<1 or co>=iw-1) else (bv if sub[rv][co]==bv else fr)
            out[i][j]=val
    return out
# verify on demos
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    p=f(gi)
    ok = p==go
    print(n, ok)

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in pts); r1=max(i for i,_ in pts)
    c0=min(j for _,j in pts); c1=max(j for _,j in pts)
    sub=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    fr=sub[0][0]
    inn=[sub[i][j] for i in range(1,len(sub)-1) for j in range(1,len(sub[0])-1) if sub[i][j]!=fr]
    bv=Counter(inn).most_common(1)[0][0]
    blk=[(i,j) for i in range(len(sub)) for j in range(len(sub[0])) if sub[i][j]==bv]
    br0=min(i for i,_ in blk); br1=max(i for i,_ in blk)
    bc0=min(j for _,j in blk); bc1=max(j for _,j in blk)
    ft=len(sub); fw=len(sub[0])
    def mrg(dim,d0,d1_,bh):
        m=max(d0,bh-d1_+1)
        while (dim+m)%2!=dim%2: m+=1   # parity of total addition matches frame parity? test variants below
        return m
    mt=mrg(ft,br0-br0,br1,br1-br0+1)  # placeholder
    return None

for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]!=bg]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in pts); r1=max(i for i,_ in pts)
    c0=min(j for _,j in pts); c1=max(j for _,j in pts)
    sub=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    fr=sub[0][0]
    inn=[sub[i][j] for i in range(1,len(sub)-1) for j in range(1,len(sub[0])-1) if sub[i][j]!=fr]
    bv=Counter(inn).most_common(1)[0][0]
    blk=[(i,j) for i in range(len(sub)) for j in range(len(sub[0])) if sub[i][j]==bv]
    br0=min(i for i,_ in blk); bc0=min(j for _,j in blk)
    op=[(i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if go[i][j]!=bg]
    Or0=min(i for i,_ in op); Oc0=min(j for _,j in op)
    # per side ring thickness: distance from frame edge to nearest box edge on that side
    tt = Or0 - r0
    bb = r1 - (max(i for i,_ in op) if False) else None
    print('demo',n,'frame',(len(sub),len(sub[0])),'blockrel',(br0,bc0),'box',(max(i for i,_ in op)-min(i for i,_ in op)+1, max(j for _,j in op)-Oc0+1))
    print('   top',tt,'bot',(max(i for i,_ in op)-r1),'left',Oc0-c0,'right',(max(j for _,j in op)-c1))

for i in (1,2,3,4,5):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(gi,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])

    print('demo',i)
    for row in sub: print(''.join(str(x) for x in row))
    print('---')

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
# gather all data points
data=[]
for i in range(1,6):
    ia=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); oa=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(ia,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    rr,cc=np.where(ia!=bg); r0_,c0_=int(rr.min()),int(cc.min())
    sub=ia[r0_:rr.max()+1,c0_:cc.max()+1]
    cs=Counter(sub.flatten()); oc=cs.most_common(1)[0][0]; ic=[c for c,v in cs.items() if c!=oc][0]
    inn=np.argwhere(sub==ic)
    ih=max(inn[:,0])+1; iw=max(inn[:,1])+1
    H,W=oa.shape
    def run(start, step):
        d=1
        while True:
            idx=start+step*d
            if idx<0 or idx>=H: break
            s=range(c0_,c0_+sub.shape[1]) if step!=1 else None
            v=all(oa[idx,c]==ic for c in s)
            if not v: break
            d+=1
        return d-1
    tt=run(r0_,-1); bb=run(r0_+sub.shape[0]+1,1); ll=run(c0_-1,-1); rt=run(c0_+sub.shape[1],1)
    # also count exact match of whole-band: use the first run-length of contiguous rows fully ic near top, bounded by non-ic
    # measure via diff mask connectivity? skip
    data.append((i,sub.shape,(r0_,c0_),H,W,t_(None),tt,bb,ll,rt,ih,iw))
print('gathered')
for x in data[:3]: print(x)

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
def solve(ti, t):
    ia=np.array(ti); H,W=ia.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(ia,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    rr,cc=np.where(ia!=bg); r0_,c0_=int(rr.min()),int(cc.min())
    sub=ia[r0_:rr.max()+1,c0_:cc.max()+1]
    out=np.zeros((H,W),dtype=int)
    # copy rect
    for r in range(r0_,r0_+sub.shape[0]):
        for c in range(c0_,c0_+sub.shape[1]):
            out[r,c]=sub[r-r0_,c-c0_]
    # ring thickness t around rect, color = inner color
    inn=np.argwhere(sub==8)
    ih=max(inn[:,0])+1; iw=max(inn[:,1])+1
    for dr in range(-t,t+1):
        for dc in range(-t,t+1):
            rr_,cc_=r0_+dr,c0_+dc
            if not (r0_-t<=rr_<r0_+sub.shape[0]+t and c0_-t<=cc_<c0_+sub.shape[1]+t): continue
            if not (r0_-t<=rr_<r0_+sub.shape[0] and c0_-t<=cc_<c0_+sub.shape[1]):
                out[rr_,cc_]=3
    return out
for tt in [1,2]:
    p=solve(G['Test input'],tt)
    print('t=',tt)
    for r in p: print(''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in r))
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'],1).tolist()))
